title: When you land
body:
Findel Airport (LUX) sits about 6km northeast of the city. Bus lines 16 and 29 run every 10–15 minutes to the city centre and central station, and — like every bus, tram and 2nd-class train in the country — they're free.

A taxi from the terminal takes roughly 15–20 minutes into town; the pickup zone has shifted to Kiss & Fly Parking C during ongoing tram construction. There's no need to buy a ticket or download a transit app before a bus ride — just board.

title: Local essentials
body:
Currency is the euro. Cards are accepted almost everywhere, including small cafés and market stalls; carrying some cash still helps for the weekend market and smaller Grund bars.

Tipping is not obligatory — Luxembourg carries no legal service charge, and rounding up the bill (or adding 5–10% for real standout service) is the norm rather than a fixed percentage.

title: Entry & documents
body:
A US passport travels visa-free into Luxembourg for stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period, under the Schengen short-stay rule — no separate Luxembourg visa needed for this trip.

Keep the passport valid at least 3 months past the return date. ETIAS pre-authorization for visa-exempt travelers is expected to start applying from late 2026; it doesn't affect this trip's October dates but is worth a check if travel plans shift later.

title: Phone & data
body: Luxembourg sits inside the EU's "roam like at home" zone, so an EU SIM or eSIM covers it at domestic rates alongside a Belgium/France/Germany trip — not useful coming straight from a US plan, though. Check your US carrier's international day-pass rate, or buy a prepaid eSIM (Airalo, Holafly, or POST Luxembourg at the airport) before landing.

title: Booking checklist
body: Nothing on this itinerary needs advance booking — Bock Casemates, the museums, and Vianden Castle all sell walk-up tickets, and the food picks below are chosen for walk-in viability. The one exception is Mousel's Cantine's dinner service, which fills up; a same-day call or its online form is worth using if arriving after 19:00.
